caption: The drawing depicts a historical dress, shown from the front in color and from the back in a faint pencil sketch. The main dress is rendered in shades of brown, tan, and muted gold, with some light reddish and bluish tones for shading and depth. The bodice is tightly fitted, featuring a deep V-shape with a pale, off-white triangular inset, and the neckline is squared with wide lapels. The sleeves are long and slightly puffed at the top, ending in turned-back cuffs that reveal a white inner lining; this same white lining appears at the end of the sleeves as undersleeves or cuffs. The skirt is very full, bell-shaped, and floor length, with soft vertical color gradations and implied pleats, showcasing the volume of the garment. In the upper right, the back view is lightly sketched, showing the same dress with basic outlines and minimal detail. The background is a plain, cream color, and no other objects are present in the drawing. The dress is shown without a head, hands, or feet, and there are no visible fastenings or additional accessories.
title: Woman's Dress
